name: Ultrakill Font
creator: agomsmoga
description:
### Overview:

* Technically replaces all fonts including Chinese/Japanese/etc, with the Ultrakill font, but this font doesn't actually include every character for those languages (or any), so if you play on a locale that uses non-ASCII characters, then it'll show blank boxes instead.
* No bold variant.
